branchName.instructions: Kebab-case slug. Prefix with the conventional-commit type of the change (feat/, fix/, chore/, refactor/, test/, docs/). Keep it short — under 50 characters.

commitMessage.instructions: Follow Conventional Commits: <type>(<scope>): <subject>, e.g. feat(config): add --config flag. Scope is the affected area in parentheses when relevant (config, session, api, tools, prompt, view, lineage). Subject in imperative mood, under 50 chars, no trailing period. Add a short body only when the why isn't obvious.

pullRequest.instructions: Summarize the diff in 2–4 sentences, list the main areas touched, and include a Testing section noting make and make test.
